notes.title: Ring the bell
notes.notes:
Information Screen & Guides are now accessible in the game.

Bot AI has been upgraded and behavior enhanced.

Referee speed increased for better gameplay flow.

Improved bot puck handling, smoother interactions.

 You can now look up without moving your hands. The default is set to thumb mouse button 1.

Push-to-Talk indicator added, A speaker icon in the bottom left corner shows push-to-talk activation.

Training mode now includes a target board with holes and bells, so you can improve your high shots and overall accuracy, while trying to ring the bells and hit the holes.


Minor bug fixes and cosmetic improvements, sprinting now resets the speed cap to its maximum.
